note: This file is a configuration file (no callable functions, classes, or APIs). It defines training hyperparameters for MAE HiViT-Large pretraining on ImageNet using MMPretrain. All logic is delegated to imported mmengine/torch modules.
review_mae_hivit_config: review the MAE HiViT-Large pretraining config for learning rate, scheduler, and optimizer settings
summarize_mae_hivit_config: summarize the MAE HiViT-Large pretraining configuration including backbone, neck, and runtime settings
build_mae_hivit_training: build a MAE HiViT-Large pretraining run on ImageNet using this config with 400 epochs
refactor_mae_hivit_config: refactor the MAE HiViT-Large config to adjust batch size, learning rate, or checkpoint frequency
test_mae_hivit_config: test the MAE HiViT-Large config by validating imports and parameter values before training
